stories.title: Southbound Blanding Boulevard closed at Youngerman Circle after crash Monday night
stories.summary: Police tape surrounded the crash site, where a visibly damaged car was seen along with a bike in the road. Details about any injuries were not immediately released.

stories.title: 'I was just scared': Clay County family seeks suspect after teenage e-bike rider is hit in crosswalk
stories.summary: Were you on Henley Road Nov. 19? A Clay County family hopes your dash cam caught the truck that hit their 14-year-old son, then drove off.

stories.title: What to expect as Thanksgiving travel ramps up at Jacksonville International Airport
stories.summary: With nearly 14,000 passengers expected to fly out of JAX by Wednesday, travelers are being encouraged to plan ahead and use its public tools.

stories.title: 600 meals distributed during annual Turkey Time food giveaway
stories.summary: Organizers say growing food insecurity and rising living costs continue to drive demand across Northeast Florida.

stories.title: Florida man who called himself an 'elite ranked pedophile' sentenced to 310 years in prison
stories.summary: Frederic Hildenbrand was arrested after years of self-produced child sexual abuse videos were uncovered following the auction of a storage unit in Northeast Florida.

stories.title: Former St. Augustine police officer arrested in Virginia for charges involving minor
stories.summary: Isaiah Beattie, 30, was arrested in Newport News on two felony charges regarding inappropriate contact with a child under the age of 15.

stories.title: St. Johns County sees record-breaking sea turtle nesting season with 1,483 nests
stories.summary: County officials said one nest belonged to a Kemp's ridley sea turtle, which is considered the rarest and most endangered sea turtle species in the world.

stories.title: Jacksonville sexual predator arrested on new child sexual abuse material charge
stories.summary: David White, a Jacksonville resident and registered sexual predator, faces a first-degree felony charge for allegedly possessing child sexual abuse material.

stories.title: 8-year-old child killed, two adults injured in crash on Oakleaf Plantation Parkway: JSO
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office said four people were taken to hospitals after the SUV hit a tree Sunday afternoon. A 7-week-old baby appeared to be uninjured.

stories.title: 'Hard to find the words': Wicked Barley Brewing Company to close after a decade of operations
stories.summary: The beloved local brewery in Goodby's Creek first opened its doors in 2016.

stories.title: Jacksonville turkey giveaway serves 450 families ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Icemen and Jacksonville Waves teamed up with Campione Law and North Florida Medical Center to hand out free turkeys on Sunday.

stories.title: Florida state offices add these 4 holiday closure dates. What to know
stories.summary: State offices will be closed on Nov. 25, Dec. 23, Dec. 24, and Dec. 31 for the holiday season.
